english.title: AATF operator/approved exporter fail to include reg 66(2) and (4) details in providing report

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an

(A)_[operator of an AATF,]_
(B)_[approved exporter,]_

in providing a report, namely **(..SPECIFY REPORT..) to **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, failed to include details of **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..) as required by regulation 66(2) and (4) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 66(2) and (4), 90(7)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
